findings.summary: `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts` was not run. The spec and the company screens belong to other units (phase-1-frontend-companies and the e2e unit) and are outside this unit's Done when. Integration must run it once those units are in (see messages[]).

messages.text: Contract command `pnpm test -- tests/api/companyRoutes.test.ts` is forwarded by the package.json script as `vitest run "--" "tests/api/companyRoutes.test.ts"`. Vitest does not match the `--` as a file filter, so it ran all 9 test files (494 tests), exit 0. The Done when passes, and it is a stronger run than the single file (55 tests, also exit 0). The script itself was not changed.

Wire contract (verified in code and tests): completedCount counts every completed diagnosis, archived ones included; with draftId, completedCount + 1 equals the rows a delete removes (the Diagnosis status enum is only draft|completed). latestStage and latestCompletedAt use only the latest completed, non-archived diagnosis. Screens that test completedCount > 0 to mean an active result must not rely on it for that.

There is no unique index on diagnoses for drafts (prisma/schema.prisma). RULE-dm-13 (one draft per company) is enforced only by the diagnoses unit's code path. draftId picks the newest draft if several exist, so the delete confirmation count (completedCount + draftId?1:0) would undercount if a second draft ever existed. Owner: phase-1-backend-diagnoses.

To run the deferred e2e check: `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts` after phase-1-frontend-companies and the e2e unit are complete. Expect it to exercise AC-dm-07 (delete confirmation count, cascade) and AC-dm-09 (search, stage filter, archived toggle) end to end. Capability-wide checks for CAP-dm-company are not approved by this local PASS.

evidence.result: vitest run: Test Files 9 passed (9); Tests 494 passed (494)

evidence.command: read-only code review of unit files (server/services/companyService.ts, server/repositories/companyRepository.ts, server/validation/companySchemas.ts, server/routes/companyRoutes.ts, server/app.ts, tests/api/companyRoutes.test.ts lines 602-680)
evidence.result: No defect in unit scope. AC-dm-07 backend behavior (409 for active company, cascade delete of all owned diagnoses in one transaction guarded by archivedAt, count before delete, 404 on repeat) and AC-dm-09 list behavior (search without accents, stage filter by latest completed, archived toggle) are implemented and covered by tests. app.ts reads the port from BACKEND_PORT with a fallback; no hardcoded port in use.
